scientific_integrity: Exact proof, rational computation and proof-vs-check distinction stated. Originality only for two-erasure minimum designs; no claim of independent confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly tetrahedral SO(3) rotations, Wigner degrees 0 and 1, unrenormalized full-design node weights; no larger bandlimit or generic nodes. Full twelve-node quadrature is prior art, 2009. Earlier equivalent frame-erasure classification cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp two-erasure recovery of low-degree Wigner signals on tetrahedral rotations
